beats.event: Insomniac from job stress; his doctor dismisses him
Fakes cancer to attend support groups for release
Marla, another faker, ruins his catharsis
Meets the charismatic Tyler Durden on a work trip
His condo is destroyed in an explosion
Moves in with Tyler in an abandoned house
First fistfight with Tyler in a parking lot
Fight club forms; men join for release
Marla and Tyler begin sleeping together
Fight club spawns Project Mayhem across cities
His friend Bob is killed in a sabotage operation
Marla reveals he and Tyler are the same person
Tyler plans to bomb a museum; narrator cannot stop him
Cornered on the roof, held at gunpoint by his other self
Shoots himself; wakes in a psych ward as plans continue
